effect.name: GM Holographic Foil
effect.desc: Angle-sensitive rainbow foil with micro-groove diffraction, crumple normals and specular movement.
effect.shader: float h(vec2 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(127.1,311.7)))*43758.5453);}void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm;vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv);vec2 cell=floor(uv*24.0);float wrinkle=(h(cell)-.5)*crumple;float phase=dot(uv,vec2(cos(lightAngle),sin(lightAngle)))*spectrumScale+wrinkle+evolution;vec3 rainbow=.5+.5*cos(6.2831853*(phase+vec3(0,.333,.667)));float groove=.65+.35*pow(.5+.5*sin(dot(uv,vec2(cos(lightAngle+1.5708),sin(lightAngle+1.5708)))*grooves),8.0);float l=dot(src.rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));vec3 foil=mix(src.rgb,rainbow*groove*(.65+.7*l),metallic)*intensity;gl_FragColor=vec4(mix(src.rgb,foil,mixAmount),src.a);}
